Asia Start is also active: Joseph needs to incorporate edits and hyperlink the Asia Start webpage in the Katya Spotlight article, and the team should save the Tech in Asia participant list and review the recap email for GP. Urgently, the team must resolve the Outlook account lockout by deleting and re-adding accounts, updating passwords, and contacting JSB to confirm the backend unlock. Upcoming items include the work report (due to Zongchao, in Chinese only), potential attendance at the World Bank Breakfast Roundtable on Oct 16, and follow-up with UN Women for the 2026 Women in Leadership Forum.
